params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Unique identifier representing a Workspace.

params.name: status
params.description: Returns only the Test Results with the specified status.

params.name: project
params.description: Project name. Returns only the Test Results of the specified project.

params.name: author
params.description: The author of the Test Result. Returns only the Test Results launched by the specified author.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of elements returned by this call. The maximum must be less than or equal to 200.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the first element to return. Starting at this offset, the query will return a maximum of 'limit' elements.

params.name: sort
params.description: The key to sort the elements on. It may begin with a '+' or a '-' to specify an ascending or descending sort order. The list of available keys can be found in the endpoint description.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the json Test Result definition.

params.name: pretty
params.description: If true the Json returned is human readable.

items.docs:
Lists the Test Results of the Workspace according to the method parameters.
___
*Sortable fields :*
  - name
  - project
  - startDate (descending sort by default : the most recent first)
  - qualityStatus

items.docs:
Provides all the Test Result raw data, with a content as CSV or JSON file.

This endpoint may produce large files depending on Test Results. For production purposes please prefer using an API client rather than the browser. Provides the Test Result raw data for an element of category TRANSACTION, with a content as CSV or JSON file.

Retention period for raw data is 7 days after which this will be permanently deleted.
